risk_description: False-positive over-pruning of canonical standard library programming constructs
mitigation_strategy: Owner policy prohibits automatic rejection; thresholds >=0.70 and >=0.85 route to manual review with AST depth weighting

risk_description: Masking operations corrupting surrounding Unicode text or docstrings
mitigation_strategy: Pre- and post-replacement Unicode NFC normalization with character offset validation

risk_description: Accidental leakage of raw email addresses in ordinary debug logs
mitigation_strategy: One-way SHA-256 entity digest recorded; raw values suppressed from ordinary logs

risk_description: Romanized Tamil or Tanglish in Latin script misclassified as English
mitigation_strategy: Combined metadata gate and LanguageIdentifierV2 particle screening; Latin script not assumed English

risk_description: Conversational crowd-worker self-disclosures evading regex entities
mitigation_strategy: Keyword narrative heuristics flag health/financial disclosures for manual review; no silent acceptance

risk_description: Ambiguous usernames or temporary identifiers silently admitted to corpus
mitigation_strategy: Uncertain identifiers routed to MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED or rejected
